name: arkpad
description: A high-performance, modular rich text editor framework built on ProseMirror.
author: ArkCabin

scripts.build: npm run build -w @arkpad/core && npm run build -w @arkpad/extension-bold && npm run build -w @arkpad/extension-italic && npm run build -w @arkpad/extension-underline && npm run build -w @arkpad/extension-strike && npm run build -w @arkpad/extension-code && npm run build -w @arkpad/extension-link && npm run build -w @arkpad/extension-heading && npm run build -w @arkpad/extension-blockquote && npm run build -w @arkpad/extension-list-item && npm run build -w @arkpad/extension-bullet-list && npm run build -w @arkpad/extension-ordered-list && npm run build -w @arkpad/extension-horizontal-rule && npm run build -w @arkpad/extension-table && npm run build -w @arkpad/extension-ai && npm run build -w @arkpad/extension-alignment && npm run build -w @arkpad/extension-bubble-menu && npm run build -w @arkpad/extension-floating-menu && npm run build -w @arkpad/extension-markdown && npm run build -w @arkpad/extension-image && npm run build -w @arkpad/extension-highlight && npm run build -w @arkpad/extension-highlighter && npm run build -w @arkpad/extension-task-list && npm run build -w @arkpad/extension-eraser && npm run build -w @arkpad/extension-superscript && npm run build -w @arkpad/extension-subscript && npm run build -w @arkpad/extension-code-block && npm run build -w @arkpad/extension-color && npm run build -w @arkpad/extension-font-family && npm run build -w @arkpad/extension-font-size && npm run build -w @arkpad/extension-placeholder && npm run build -w @arkpad/extension-typography && npm run build -w @arkpad/extension-youtube && npm run build -w @arkpad/react && npm run build -w @arkpad/starter-kit && npm run build -w @arkpad/app
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @arkpad/core && npm run build -w @arkpad/react && npm run typecheck --workspaces
scripts.check: npm run build && npm run typecheck && npm run lint
scripts.test:extensions: for ext in bold italic underline strike code superscript subscript highlight color font-family font-size heading blockquote horizontal-rule code-block link image bullet-list ordered-list list-item task-list table alignment markdown placeholder; do npx vitest run --config packages/extension-$ext/vitest.config.ts packages/extension-$ext/src/__tests__/ > /dev/null 2>&1 && echo PASS: $ext || echo FAIL: $ext; done
scripts.test:all: npm run test && npm run test:extensions
